principle: A release gate closes only when the required production artifact exists and its applicable QA/platform evidence is present.

characterMeshAAA.acceptance: Final production skeletal mesh is imported, referenced by the playable character, and signed off by content QA.

rigFacialAnimation.acceptance: Final skeleton/rig, animation set, facial setup and gameplay animation coverage are present and QA signed off.

pbrVfx.acceptance: Final authored PBR materials/textures/VFX are present, referenced by final assets, and content QA signed off.

finalMaps.acceptance: Final playable maps are authored in Unreal Editor and contain the release World Partition/Data Layer/HLOD setup.

audioVO.acceptance: Final mixed audio and approved voice-over are imported, referenced and content-QA signed off.

cinematics.acceptance: Final Level Sequences/cinematic assets are authored, integrated and reviewed.

localization.acceptance: All release languages pass linguistic, functional, truncation, terminology and in-game QA.

PS5.requirement: Authorized PS5 SDK/development kit execution with recorded profiling results.

XboxSeries.requirement: Authorized Xbox Series X/S SDK/development kit execution with recorded profiling results.

Switch2.requirement: Authorized Nintendo Switch 2 SDK/development kit execution with recorded profiling results.

PSN.requirement: Actual first-party PSN integration and authorized credentials validated in the production target.

Xbox.requirement: Actual first-party Xbox integration and authorized credentials validated in the production target.

Nintendo.requirement: Actual first-party Nintendo integration and authorized credentials validated in the production target.

distributionSigning.requirement: Actual production signing manifest for releasable binaries.

trcTcrCertification.requirement: Actual platform certification execution and approval record.
